summary: Tighter control over how long a share lives and how often it can be opened.

features.title: View limits
features.short: Stop a share after a set number of openings
features.description: Set how many times a share may be opened. Every share counts its openings either way, but with a subscription the count becomes a limit: once it is reached the link stops working, whatever time is left on it. Useful for something meant for one person, once.

features.title: Automatic deletion
features.short: Destroy a share the moment it expires
features.description: Choose what happens when a share runs out of time. Without a subscription an expired share is locked but kept, so you can extend it later. With one you can have it deleted instead — the encrypted content is destroyed on the next scheduler tick and no link brings it back.
